name: guardian-mcp-server
description: Search, browse, and retrieve full article text from The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search, browse, and retrieve full article text from The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: guardian-mcp-server puts The Guardian's journalism archive (1999–present) behind MCP. guardian_search runs full-text search across the archive with section, tag, contributor, and date filters, returning articles with body text; guardian_browse walks the paper's structure — latest articles for a section or tag, plus discovery modes listing the available sections and tags to use as filters; guardian_get_article fetches a single article by ID with complete, untruncated body text and metadata. Powered by the Guardian Open Platform (open-platform.theguardian.com).
